items.docs: This endpoint issues a client token that can be used with client-side requests to the Neon APIs. Expires in 24 hours.

info.name: Create a checkout using a client token

items.docs: Create a checkout. Once the checkout is created, redirect the user to the `redirectUrl`. See [Create a checkout using a client token](https://docs.neonpay.com/reference/createcheckoutclient) for more information. Don't use this API if you have a Neon storefront set up. Neon storefronts handle creating checkouts on your behalf.

info.name: Mark an unclaimed purchase as claimed

items.docs:
Mark a purchase as claimed. This is required if you are using a serverless flow.
The response is signed with `X-Neon-Signature-` headers for verification. To verify the signature, construct the payload as `{timestamp}.{responseBody}` and verify using the public key from the dashboard.

info.name: Get all unclaimed purchases for a particular user

items.docs:
Returns a data object containing the list of unclaimed purchases for the user.
The response is signed with `X-Neon-Signature-` headers for verification. To verify the signature, construct the payload as `{timestamp}.{responseBody}` and verify using the public key from the dashboard.
